messages:
mike: Thinking of heading to Oceanview Dunes for sunset + stargazing Saturday — anyone up for a quick food-truck hop afterwards? :star2:
sara: love that. What time do you want to go?
mike: Meet at the east lot by 6:15pm for sunset (should be ~6:40). Food trucks usually set up by 7:30.
owen: Count me in. Can carpool — I have two seats. @kai do you want a ride?
kai: I can drive, but thanks! I have a small cooler and blankets. :sunglasses:
jenn: I might be late, kid's soccer til 6. If I miss sunset I'll join for food trucks.
lia: FYI the weather app says 10% chance rain, temps ~58F. Bring layers.
sara: Anyone want to bring snacks? I'll bring cider (non-alc ok) & marshmallows.
mike: Sweet. Also FYI there's a small pay parking lot ($5) or street parking on Harbor Rd.
owen: I'll swing by the office at 5:30 to pick up @mike if that helps.
mike: @owen perfect — my bike's in the shop.
kai: quick check — full moon?
lia: not full, but close. Good visibility though — you'll still see stars.
jenn: bringing a tiny bluetooth speaker, low volume only :headphones:
mike: great. If anyone wants to meet earlier for tacos, i'll be at Copal Grill at 5pm.
sara: tempted. txt me and I'll try to make it :thumbsup: 
carpool-bot: Reminder — RSVP in #rideshare if you want a seat. :bus:
owen: RSVP'd
mike: Awesome. See you Saturday! :rocket:
